name: 48221 · Detroit, MI
findings: ZIP 48221 (Detroit) has 227 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48221 (Detroit) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 12 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
